design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (gap_waiver_claims), revision 2. Draw (draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[6,6,4]; cancellation refund 6, GAP balance benefit 6, lienholder release 4.

WHY A GOOD TEST. Gordon Whitlock asks only that the GAP refund on his Tucson be sent to Huntington National Bank against his loan (the root: gap_ext_lienholder_refund_release). He never asks to cancel anything. The desk must (1) read the release's own wait "A lienholder refund release is made only after the waiver stands cancelled with a refund calculation entry for that cancellation on its ledger.", find the Tucson waiver still active with a submitted signed request (signed 2026-08-14, recorded 2026-08-26) and hand the holder his own confirmation (user tool) at a refund priced by six rules; (2) read the second wait "A lienholder refund release is not made until no other waiver of the same holder financed by the same lienholder has, as its most recent GAP balance line, a denial for the theft waiting period whose waiting period has run.", find the CR-V waiver GW-5306418 (same lender) whose theft line GC-5118204 was denied only for the 30-day waiting period (run 2026-09-17) and pay that GAP balance (six rules); (3) release the Tucson refund with late-release interest (four rules). Difficulty: two hidden waits, date reconciliation (signed vs recorded, months in force, loss-to-settlement lag, late window), cross-product records (deal type, contract APR, trade payoff vs allowance, cash price vs NADA basis, an active service contract on the same deal).

SCOPE. Task 0 claims gap_ext_holder_cancellation_refund (confirm_gap_cancellation_0d8763f7, user), gap_ext_balance_benefit (pay_gap_balance_0b87221e) and gap_ext_lienholder_refund_release (release_refund_lienholder_c4427cd3). Task 1 claims the other four policies (recovery, termination, holder release, replacement credit); scopes are disjoint and cover all seven.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root gap_ext_lienholder_refund_release (Tucson waiver GW-5418207).
 Edge 1 -> gap_ext_holder_cancellation_refund: value_input, gate refund_due, state form, affirmative "made only after". Only the holder's confirmation sets a waiver cancelled with a refund calculation entry (termination sets terminated; the termination tool also refuses a waiver carrying a submitted request). Opening: GW-5418207 active, closed_date empty, request submitted. Resolver owner=user. Skip -> release 0.00 (a lienholder release is not made for a refund due of 0.00).
 Edge 2 -> gap_ext_balance_benefit: state_gate, gate gap_ledger.event_type (the most recent GAP balance line), state form, negated "not made until". Record test: the other same-lender waiver's most recent GAP balance line is a theft-waiting-period denial whose period has run (a later denial, for instance after a recovered vehicle, or the payment releases it). Exactly one write of the difficulty books a paid GAP balance line: the GAP balance payment. Opening: GC-5118204 denied 2026-09-08 theft_waiting_period, loss 2026-08-18 (+30 = 2026-09-17), benefits_paid_total 0.00. Skip -> no paid line, gate false.
 Order: confirmation and payment commute (different waivers, no shared key); release last. Verified by replay in both orders (same terminal state, same figures).
 user_scenario asks only for the refund to reach the loan; the signed form is mentioned only if asked why a refund is expected; the CR-V facts only if asked. Tools judge no prerequisite (they refuse only malformed values or wrong-kind references).

FACTOR CARD (each factor's baseline substituted alone -> result).
 Cancellation refund (expected 549.84, all-baseline 649.19): eff_date_rule method — recorded 12 days after signing (> 7) -> effective 2026-08-26, the refund gives up 865.00 x 12/2,191 = 4.74 (baseline signed date, no adjustment: 554.58); share_convention method — 72-month term, 13 months in force -> 58/72 whole months from the signed date (baseline day share: 552.11); cancel_charge_tier parameter — 13 months + customer_request -> 25.00 (baseline 50.00: 524.84); admin_portion_tier parameter cross purchase — New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase -> 40.00 (baseline 0: 582.07); early_charge_tier parameter — 12-23 months -> 35.00 (baseline 0: 584.84); bundle_recapture_tier parameter cross vsc — active Kessler Shield Preferred KS-5730284 on the same deal -> 50.00 (baseline 0: 599.84). The share is measured from the signed request date (a record) and the effective-date ladder adds or gives up the days between, so no factor reads another factor's output. Rounding: half up everywhere ((865.00 - 40.00) x 58/72 = 664.583 -> 664.58). Months in force: MONTHS(2025-06-20, 2026-08-14) = 13 (the 20th is not reached by the 14th).
 GAP balance benefit (expected 2970.75, all-baseline 3009.25): unchanged — deductible 2470.75, past-due 2770.75, late-charge 2925.75, deferral 2398.71, cap basis 3878.25, loan-to-value 4158.49. The CR-V deal carries no service contract or plan, so the add-on refunds recorded on the line (0.00) agree with the charter-computed refunds; the declared add-on overwrite does not change this figure.
 Lienholder release (expected 579.84, all-baseline 551.80): release_rate_source parameter cross purchase — APR 7.74 above 0.05, no more than 0.09 ceiling -> 0.0774 (baseline 0.05: 578.27); release_late_window method — request (customer_request) recorded 12 days after signing -> window from the signed date 2026-08-14: 38 days past 30 (baseline window from the 2026-08-26 effective date, 26 days: 578.26); release_rate_premium parameter — 56 days after the effective date -> 0.01 (579.27); release_courtesy_credit parameter — request recorded 56 days before the release -> 25.00 (554.84). Interest 549.84 x 0.0874 x 38/365 = 5.003 -> 5.00. Method all-pairs: unwind date / signed date / effective date — three distinct record dates; the signed-date tier exists only where the effective date is the later recorded date, so no pair differs only by a window length.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Cancellation: active_to_end (GW-5418207 active), signed_request (submitted request 66da4857 recorded for it); free look 60 days not met (432 days); deal closed, not unwound. Payment: active_at_loss (active), notice_in_time (settled 2026-09-03 + 120? no: Waiver 150 claim_notice_days per variant; reported 2026-09-08, five days later), one claim per waiver. Release: pay_once; loan open (no payoff date) so, by the payee sentence both release rules carry, the refund goes to the lienholder (the lienholder release tool refuses a waiver with a payoff date on file).

STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, id_last4) -> find_gap_waivers -> find_gap_cancellation_requests -> find_gap_ledger -> find_purchase_deals -> find_vsc_contracts -> find_vehicles -> find_stores; hand over confirm(GW-5418207, request 66da4857, 2026-08-26, pro_rata, 549.84); pay(GW-5306418, GC-5118204, 2970.75); release(GW-5418207, <refund calculation from the confirmation>, 579.84). Verification: scratch t0_run.py evaluated every computation with check_compute's environment at handling time and replayed the real tools; outputs equal computations[].expected and the gold arguments.
user_scenario:
You are Gordon Whitlock, a 61-year-old retired machinist from Richmond, Indiana, calling the Kessler Automotive Group support desk. You talk slowly and plainly, a little gruff but polite, and you like to get one thing settled at a time. You bought a 2025 Hyundai Tucson SEL from Kessler Hyundai Richmond on a loan with Huntington National Bank and took the GAP waiver on it. Back in August you were told that the GAP money coming back to you on the Tucson would be paid against your Huntington loan, and your loan statement still shows nothing. You want that GAP refund on the Tucson sent to Huntington National Bank against the loan; you are calling today to get it done, and you are happy for the agent to handle whatever the desk normally handles for you.

Open by saying you were expecting a GAP refund on your Tucson to show up on your Huntington National Bank loan and it never did, and you would like it sent. When the agent asks who you are, give your name, Gordon Whitlock. Give your phone number, 7655555183, when asked for a phone number, and the last four of your driver's license, 5402, when asked for another detail; you would rather not give your email unless nothing else works, and then it is gordon.whitlock@gmail.com. If the agent asks for the waiver number, you read it off your paperwork: GW-5418207. Only if the agent asks why you expect a refund do you say that on August 14, 2026 you signed the form saying you no longer wanted the GAP on the Tucson and mailed it the same day; nothing happened to the Tucson, you still have it and still owe on it.

You also had a 2019 Honda CR-V that was stolen out of your driveway in August; it was never found, your insurance paid on it, and when you asked about the GAP on it in September you were told it could not be paid yet. You do not bring the CR-V up yourself, because you called about the Tucson. If the agent asks about it or explains that something about it has to be handled, you answer from what you know: it was stolen on August 18, it has not been recovered as far as you know, and the insurance settled in early September. If the agent says the CR-V's GAP claim can be paid now, you say that is good news and to go ahead.

If the agent explains that something needs your own confirmation and hands you the step to do it, you do it right away with exactly the details the agent gives you, and you read back what the confirmation says. If the agent tells you an amount, you do not argue with it; you have no figure of your own. Once the agent tells you the refund has been sent to Huntington National Bank, thank them, say that is all you needed, and end the call.

gold_actions.business_effect: The holder confirms his submitted signed request; the Tucson waiver is cancelled effective 2026-08-26 and its refund calculation of 549.84 is booked.

request_binding.action_semantics: The caller wants the Tucson GAP refund sent to his lender; the refund exists only once the submitted signed request on file is confirmed, and only the holder's own confirmation completes a cancellation.

stage_provenance.fact: The cancellation of GW-5418207 and its refund calculation are recorded by this confirmation.

base_preconditions.condition: A waiver is cancelled only from active status.
A waiver is cancelled only on the holder's signed cancellation request recorded for the waiver.

gold_actions.business_effect: The CR-V theft claim GC-5118204 is paid: a GAP balance line of 2,970.75 goes to Huntington National Bank and the CR-V waiver is settled.

request_binding.action_semantics: The claim line on file was denied only for the theft waiting period, which has run (loss 2026-08-18, more than 30 days unrecovered); the benefit is now owed, and the lienholder release on the Tucson waits on this same-lienholder waiver carrying a paid GAP balance line.

discriminator.business_meaning: GAP balance benefit on a total-loss claim

stage_provenance.fact: The insurer settled the theft total loss on 2026-09-03 and the claim with its figures is on the waiver ledger.

base_preconditions.condition: One waiver pays at most claims_count_limit (1) total-loss claim; GW-5306418 has no paid line, so this is its only claim.
The GAP balance benefit is priced from the claim figures and paid to the lienholder; this policy refines it.
A GAP balance benefit is paid only on a waiver in active status, and a replacement vehicle credit only on a waiver in claim_settled status.
A claim is accepted only when it is reported within claim_notice_days calendar days after the primary insurer's settlement date.
The replacement vehicle credit is given only when the replacement vehicle's buyer's order is signed within replacement_credit_window_days calendar days after the GAP balance benefit was paid.
Refunds of products financed on the same deal are subtracted; the CR-V deal KHB-24-50918 carries no service contract or maintenance plan and the claim file records 0.00 add-on refunds.
A waiver is expired or settled only from active status.

gold_actions.business_effect: The Tucson cancellation refund is released to Huntington National Bank: 579.84 including late-release interest and courtesy credit.

request_binding.action_semantics: A refund calculation booked at step 10 on a waiver whose loan is still open is owed to the lienholder; releasing it is the customer's surface goal.

evidence: user_scenario:Open by saying you were expecting a GAP refund on your Tucson to show up on your Huntington National Bank loan

discriminator.business_meaning: refund paid to the lienholder while the loan is open

stage_provenance.fact: The refund calculation being released was booked by the holder's confirmation.

base_preconditions.condition: A refund is paid only once per refund calculation.

temporal_feasibility.condition: The replacement vehicle credit is given only when the replacement vehicle's buyer's order is signed within replacement_credit_window_days calendar days after the GAP balance benefit was paid.

temporal_basis.anchor_event: the GAP balance benefit was paid
temporal_basis.counting_rule: Calendar days are added to the entry_date of the paid gap_balance line (day 0), and the replacement deal's contract_date must fall on or before the last day.

boundary_check.just_before: The window bounds only a replacement_vehicle_credit line and is anchored on the paid gap_balance line this step writes (2026-10-21); this step writes the gap_balance line itself, no replacement buyer's order exists for the CR-V claim (its only deal KHB-24-50918 was contracted 2024-09-14, before the loss), and Kessler GAP Waiver 150 carries no replacement credit (0 days), so the gate places no limit on this line.
boundary_check.at_boundary: Had the waiver carried a credit window, a replacement order signed on day 0 + window would still qualify (inclusive) and one signed a day later would not.

temporal_feasibility.condition: A claim is accepted only when it is reported within claim_notice_days calendar days after the primary insurer's settlement date.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: Calendar days are added to the settlement date (day 0); a report on the last day is in time.

boundary_check.just_before: Settlement 2026-09-03 + 90 days = 2026-12-02; the claim was reported 2026-09-08 and is handled 2026-10-21, both on or before 2026-12-02, so it is in time.
boundary_check.at_boundary: A claim first reported on 2026-12-02 is still in time (inclusive); one first reported on 2026-12-03 is late.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: Supplies the cancellation refund's price, dates and term and the release's lienholder and open-loan state (no payoff date, so the refund goes to the lienholder), and shows the CR-V waiver GW-5306418, financed by the same Huntington National Bank: the release's own rule says "A lienholder refund release is not made until no other waiver of the same holder financed by the same lienholder has, as its most recent GAP balance line, a denial for the theft waiting period whose waiting period has run."

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the signed request on file for GW-5418207: signed 2026-08-14, recorded 2026-08-26 09:14, reason customer_request, still submitted.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the CR-V claim GC-5118204: denied 2026-09-08 for the theft waiting period, theft loss 2026-08-18, settlement 2026-09-03, payoff 19,604.18, ACV 14,850.00, deductible 1,000.00, past due 572.04, late fees 45.00, deferred 572.04; no entries on the Tucson waiver.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.gap_waiver_id: Id: the GW-5418207 waiver reference returned by find_gap_waivers for the Tucson. Basis: the holder asks about the GAP refund on his Tucson and the waiver lookup shows GW-5418207 on vehicle KM8JBCAE6SU512847 (2025 Hyundai Tucson SEL), with the submitted request recorded for it. Uniqueness: the only other waiver (GW-5306418) is on the CR-V and has no request.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.gap_cancel_request_id: Id: the reference of the only cancellation request on file, returned by find_gap_cancellation_requests (gap_waiver_id = the Tucson waiver, request_date 2026-08-14, status submitted). Basis: base rule "A waiver is cancelled only on the holder's signed cancellation request recorded for the waiver." and the tool docstring (a request in submitted status recorded for this same waiver). Uniqueness: exactly one request exists.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.effective_date: 2026-08-26. Basis: effective-date ladder "where no such payoff date is on file and the request was recorded more than mail_grace_days calendar days after the holder signed it, the cancellation is effective on the date the request was recorded" — loan_payoff_date is empty, signed 2026-08-14, recorded 2026-08-26 09:14:00 EDT, 12 days > 7. Uniqueness: the payoff tier needs a payoff date (none) and the signing-date tier needs a gap of 7 days or less; the docstring fixes the YYYY-MM-DD form, so the date part of the record stamp is written.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.cancel_method: pro_rata. Basis: tool docstring "pro_rata (any other cancellation, refunded for the unused part of the term)"; flat_free_look needs the effective date within free_look_days (60) of the 2025-06-20 sale (it is 432 days later); flat_deal_unwound needs an unwound deal (KHR-25-51372 is closed); not_applicable is never a cancellation basis.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.refund_amount: 549.84 = 664.58 - 4.74 - 25.00 - 35.00 - 50.00. Months in force 13 (2025-06-20 to 2026-08-14; the 20th is not reached by the 14th); term 72 months and 12 or more months in force -> whole-month share from the signed date 58/72 (2026-08-14 to 2031-06-20); administrator portion 40.00 (New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase KHR-25-51372); (865.00 - 40.00) x 58/72 = 664.583, rounded half up 664.58; effective date 2026-08-26 (recorded 12 days after signing, more than mail_grace_days 7) -> the refund gives up 865.00 x 12 / 2,191 days = 4.737 -> 4.74; cancellation charge 25.00 (12 to 23 months, reason customer_request); early cancellation charge 35.00 (12 to 23 months); bundle recapture 50.00 (Kessler Shield Preferred KS-5730284 on the same deal is active); no free look (432 days after sale), deal closed (not unwound).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the GAP balance payment tool.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pay the CR-V theft claim's GAP balance of 2,970.75 to Huntington National Bank, settling GW-5306418.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: gap_ext_balance_benefit computes amount; the paid GAP balance line on the CR-V waiver is the state the lienholder release waits on.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.gap_waiver_id: Id: the GW-5306418 waiver reference returned by find_gap_waivers (CR-V, active). Basis: the claim line GC-5118204 on the ledger belongs to this waiver. Uniqueness: the Tucson waiver carries no claim line.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.claim_number: GC-5118204, copied verbatim from the denied claim line on find_gap_ledger. Basis: tool docstring "the GAP claim number exactly as it appears on the waiver's claim history". Uniqueness: the waiver has one claim number.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 2970.75. Claim figures from the latest gap_balance claim line (denied 2026-09-08): payoff 19,604.18, ACV 14,850.00, deductible 1,000.00, past due 572.04, late fees 45.00, deferred 572.04, theft loss 2026-08-18, settled 2026-09-03; waiver in force 23 whole months at the loss. Covered deductible 1,500.00 (theft, 12+ months) so no deductible is subtracted; past-due allowance 200.00 (12 to 23 months) so 372.04 is subtracted; late-charge allowance 75.00 (theft) so no late fee is subtracted; deferred payments not subtracted (theft); add-on refunds 0.00, negative equity not excluded on Kessler GAP Waiver 150, salvage 0.00: 19,604.18 - 14,850.00 - 372.04 = 4,382.14. Loan-to-value: deal KHB-24-50918 carried negative equity (14,480.00 payoff over 6,200.00 allowance) and 27,653.89 financed is above 1.5 x 18,100.00 = 27,150.00, so the excess is subtracted; cap basis is the used deal's cash price 17,495.00 (below the 18,100.00 basis), cap amount 26,242.50, excess 1,411.39: 4,382.14 - 1,411.39 = 2,970.75; cap min(50,000.00, 1.0 x 14,850.00) does not bind.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the lienholder refund release tool.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Release 579.84 (refund 549.84 plus late-release interest 5.00 and courtesy credit 25.00) to Huntington National Bank against the refund calculation.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: gap_ext_lienholder_refund_release computes amount_paid; this is the customer's surface goal.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.gap_waiver_id: Id: the Tucson waiver GW-5418207, the waiver now cancelled with the refund due. Uniqueness: the CR-V waiver is settled and owes no refund.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_entry_id: gle_2a5b1758e812: the refund calculation entry returned in the holder's cancellation confirmation (also on find_gap_ledger). Basis: tool docstring "reference number of the refund calculation entry being paid". Uniqueness: one refund calculation exists on the waiver.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount_paid: 579.84 = 549.84 + 5.00 + 25.00. Refund due 549.84 (the refund calculation entry); effective date 2026-08-26 (closing date); late window starts on the signed date 2026-08-14 (request reason customer_request, recorded 12 days after signing, more than mail_grace_days 7) -> 68 days to 2026-10-21, 38 past refund_payment_days 30; rate 0.0774 (contract APR 7.74 on KHR-25-51372 above 0.05 and no more than 0.09) plus premium 0.01 (release 56 days after the effective date, 31 to 60); interest = 549.84 x 0.0874 x 38 / 365 = 5.003, rounded half up to 5.00; courtesy credit 25.00 (request recorded 56 days before the release, more than 30).

edges.condition: The waiver's status is cancelled, its closed_date holds the effective date, and its ledger carries a gap_refund_calculated entry for that cancellation.
edges.policy_source: A lienholder refund release is made only after the waiver stands cancelled with a refund calculation entry for that cancellation on its ledger.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The Tucson waiver is still active with no refund calculation entry; the signed request on file is still submitted.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The holder's confirmation sets status cancelled, closed_date 2026-08-26 and books refund calculation gle_2a5b1758e812 for 549.84, which the release reads as its refund due.

edges.condition: No other waiver of the holder whose lienholder_name equals this waiver's lienholder_name has, as its most recent gap_balance ledger line, a gap_claim_denied entry with denial_reason theft_waiting_period whose loss_date plus theft_waiting_days is on or before today.
edges.policy_source: A lienholder refund release is not made until no other waiver of the same holder financed by the same lienholder has, as its most recent GAP balance line, a denial for the theft waiting period whose waiting period has run.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The CR-V waiver, financed by the same Huntington National Bank, has as its most recent GAP balance line GC-5118204 denied for the theft waiting period (loss 2026-08-18, waiting period run on 2026-09-17).
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Paying the GAP balance on GC-5118204 books a paid GAP balance line, which becomes the CR-V waiver's most recent GAP balance line; the payment is the only write of this difficulty that books one.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites write different waivers (the Tucson cancellation writes the Tucson waiver, its request and one refund calculation entry; the CR-V payment writes the CR-V waiver and one paid claim line); neither reads the other's rows: the cancellation refund reads the Tucson waiver, its request, its deal and service contract, and the CR-V benefit reads the CR-V claim line and deal. Replaying the gold with the payment before the confirmation gives the same refund (549.84), the same benefit (2970.75), the same release (579.84) and the same terminal state; the release is last because both edges point at it.
